item.title: 1955 Chevrolet Corvette 265
item.description: This 1955 Chevrolet Corvette is the 462nd of 700 examples produced for the model year, and refurbishment work between 2016 and 2019 involved refinishing the body in white, reupholstering the interior in red, and rebuilding the 265ci V8 paired and two-speed Powerglide automatic transmission. item.description: This 1988 Mercury Grand Marquis Colony Park LS wagon is finished in Oxford White with woodgrain appliques over blue velour upholstery and is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission. It features a roof rack, power steering, front disc brakes, 15″ turbine-style wheels, air conditioning, cruise control, power-adjustable front seats, flat-folding third-row seats, and a Pioneer CD stereo along with power windows, mirrors, and door locks. item.title: 1951 Chevrolet 3100 5-Window Pickup
item.description: This 1951 Chevrolet 3100 five-window pickup was refurbished prior to 2018 and purchased by the seller in 2022. The body is finished in green and features a split windshield, a five-window cab, a wood-plank bed floor, and running boards. Inside, the bench seat has been re-trimmed in gray vinyl with green houndstooth cloth inserts. item.title: LS3-Powered 1971 Ford F-100 Sport Custom 6-Speed
item.description: This 1971 Ford F-100 Sport Custom pickup was retrofitted with a 6.2-liter LS3 V8 and a T56 six-speed transmission during a build completed by the current owner in 2024. The engine has been modified with an uprated camshaft, lifters, and dual valve springs, and long-tube headers flow to a custom exhaust system. item.title: 1967 Alfa Romeo 1600 Spider Duetto Project at No Reserve
item.description: This 1967 Alfa Romeo 1600 Spider Duetto was last registered in 1995. It was not running when it was acquired in 2016 by the seller, and it remains a partially disassembled project. A twin-cam 1,570cc inline-four, a five-speed manual transmission, four-wheel disc brakes, and 15" wheels are on the car, and a collection of removed and spare parts are included in the sale. This boat-tail Spider project is offered at no reserve with a clean California title in the seller's name.

item.title: 28k-Mile 2017 BMW i8 Protonic Frozen Yellow Edition
item.description: This 2017 BMW i8 Protonic Frozen Yellow Edition features a Valvetronic Designs exhaust system, 22” HRE P101 wheels, H&R lowering springs, and a Maxton Design front splitter, rear diffuser, and side skirts. It is finished in Protonic Frozen Yellow over Giga Amido Black leather and is powered by a turbocharged 1.5-liter inline-three paired with a six-speed automatic transaxle as well as an eDrive electric motor with an integrated two-speed automatic gearbox. item.title: 1957 Alfa Romeo 1900C Super Sprint by Touring
item.description: This 1957 Alfa Romeo 1900C is one of approximately 854 Super Sprints built during three years of production and was completed on March 25, 1957, before being delivered new to Mocar Alfa Romeo in Lisbon, Portugal. Chassis 10473 is noted to have been recovered in 2007 from a barn located in Portugal after a period of long-term storage, after which it was relocated to Italy.
